query: select "public"."events"."name", count(*) from "public"."events" where ("public"."events"."received_at" >= cast($1 as timestamp(3) with time zone) and "public"."events"."received_at" < cast($2 as timestamp(3) with time zone)) group by "public"."events"."name" order by count(*) desc, "public"."events"."name" asc fetch next $3 rows only

select date_trunc('day', "public"."events"."received_at", 'Asia/Seoul'), count(*) from "public"."events" where ("public"."events"."received_at" >= cast($1 as timestamp(3) with time zone) and "public"."events"."received_at" < cast($2 as timestamp(3) with time zone)) group by date_trunc('day', "public"."events"."received_at", 'Asia/Seoul')

insert into "public"."events" ("event_id", "installation_id", "name", "occurred_at", "sdk_version", "properties") values (cast($1 as uuid), cast($2 as uuid), $3, cast($4 as timestamp(3) with time zone), $5, cast($6 as jsonb)) on conflict ("event_id") do nothing
SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

select "public"."events"."event_id", "public"."events"."installation_id", "public"."events"."name", "public"."events"."occurred_at", "public"."events"."received_at", "public"."events"."sdk_version" from "public"."events" where ("public"."events"."received_at" >= cast($1 as timestamp(3) with time zone) and "public"."events"."received_at" < cast($2 as timestamp(3) with time zone)) order by "public"."events"."received_at" desc, "public"."events"."event_id" desc fetch next $3 rows only
